name: corpus
description: Find the work context and original sources behind a task, then carry that context into later work.

interface.shortDescription: Connect each task to its work context and sources
interface.longDescription: Corpus connects a task to the files, email, and completed AI work that belong to the same body of work, then opens the original sources needed now. Source-linked context can carry the work into later tasks. Registered files and provider records remain unchanged; indexes and saved context stay on this Mac. Archived contexts remain readable, and permanent deletion is not available.
capabilities: Selected views without private source links
defaultPrompt: Show the work contexts and materials Corpus can help me continue.
Find which work context this task belongs to and open the original sources I need.
Show what Corpus actually used in this task.
